<module id="asyn_fifo">
    <description>Asynchronous FIFO with configurable depth and width.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="wclk">Write clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rclk">Read clock signal.</input>
        <input id="wrstn">Write reset signal (active low).</input>
        <input id="rrstn">Read reset signal (active low).</input>
        <input id="winc">Write increment signal.</input>
        <input id="rinc">Read increment signal.</input>
        <input id="wdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Write data input.</input>
        <output id="wfull">Write full signal.</output>
        <output id="rempty">Read empty signal.</output>
        <output id="rdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Read data output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="WIDTH">8</parameter>
        <parameter id="DEPTH">16</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="waddr_bin" width_description="$clog2(DEPTH)" init_value="0">Write address register.</reg>
        <reg id="raddr_bin" width_description="$clog2(DEPTH)" init_value="0">Read address register.</reg>
        <reg id="wptr" width_description="$clog2(DEPTH)" init_value="0">Write pointer in Gray code.</reg>
        <reg id="rptr" width_description="$clog2(DEPTH)" init_value="0">Read pointer in Gray code.</reg>
        <reg id="wptr_buff" width_description="$clog2(DEPTH)" init_value="0">Buffer for write pointer.</reg>
        <reg id="rptr_buff" width_description="$clog2(DEPTH)" init_value="0">Buffer for read pointer.</reg>
        <wire id="wfull_int">Internal write full signal.</wire>
        <wire id="rempty_int">Internal read empty signal.</wire>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Write pointer management
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                waddr_bin <= 0;
                wptr <= 0;
            end else begin
                if (winc) begin
                    waddr_bin <= (waddr_bin + 1) % DEPTH;
                    wptr <= {~rptr[msb(wptr)], rptr[$clog2(DEPTH)-1:1]};
                end
            end
        end

        // Read pointer management
        always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                raddr_bin <= 0;
                rptr <= 0;
            end else begin
                if (rinc) begin
                    raddr_bin <= (raddr_bin + 1) % DEPTH;
                    rptr <= {~wptr[msb(rptr)], wptr[$clog2(DEPTH)-1:1]};
                end
            end
        end

        // Gray code conversion
        always @(*) begin
            wptr = {~rptr[msb(wptr)], rptr[$clog2(DEPTH)-1:1]};
            rptr = {~wptr[msb(rptr)], wptr[$clog2(DEPTH)-1:1]};
        end

        // Pointer buffers
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                wptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                wptr_buff <= wptr;
            end
        end

        always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                rptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                rptr_buff <= rptr;
            end
        end

        // Full and empty detection
        assign wfull_int = wptr == {~rptr[msb(wptr)], rptr[$clog2(DEPTH)-1:1]};
        assign rempty_int = rptr == wptr;

        // Connect to dual-port RAM
        always @(posedge wclk or posedge rclk) begin
            if (winc && !wfull_int) begin
                dual_port_RAM.wenc <= 1;
                dual_port_RAM.waddr <= waddr_bin;
                dual_port_RAM.wdata <= wdata;
            end else begin
                dual_port_RAM.wenc <= 0;
            end

            if (rinc && !rempty_int) begin
                dual_port_RAM.renc <= 1;
                dual_port_RAM.raddr <= raddr_bin;
            end else begin
                dual_port_RAM.renc <= 0;
            end
        end

        // Output assignment
        assign wfull = wfull_int;
        assign rempty = rempty_int;
        assign rdata = dual_port_RAM.rdata;
    </implementation>
</module>
